sourceTitle: Lennox SL280DFNV installation instructions 508150-02 (04/2024), integrated control diagnostic codes
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
displayPattern: Seven-segment diagnostic LED on a Lennox SL280DFNV.
meaning: Soft lockout: retries ran out and no flame current was sensed.
causes: No flame current sensed on the last retries
diySteps: Confirm the manual gas shutoff serving the furnace is open, and that another gas appliance in the house still lights. If nothing gas lights, call the gas supplier from outside
Technician: confirm the ignitor is lighting the burner and check flame-sensor current. The code clears when a heat call finishes successfully
proAdvice: E270 is the retry lockout for no flame current. It is not E223 (pressure switch) and not E200 (rollout). If the gas is on and it will not finish a heat call, call a licensed HVAC technician.
